name: Chiba

flag.description: A white four-pointed emblem edged in pale yellow on a sky-blue field: the katakana チ (chi) and ハ (ha) combined.
flag.symbolism: チハ spells Chiba; the yellow edge recalls the rapeseed blossom, the prefectural flower, and the sky blue stands for hope.

hook: Chiba's white star on blue is チ (chi) stacked on ハ (ha), edged in rapeseed yellow.
trivia: Narita International Airport and Tokyo Disney Resort are both in Chiba, not Tokyo.
Its emblem, from 1909, is the oldest prefectural emblem still in use apart from Tokyo's.
